expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
expectations.evidence: B0 names 'Complicated' explicitly and adds: 'Flagging that without per-theme discovery evidence, this drifts toward Complex — at which point deterministic milestones like 60/30/10 allocation are themselves a defect.' Multiple emergent dimensions noted.

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
expectations.evidence: Inputs section: 'Tier: Full — selected because plan appetite > 1 week (a full quarter), and the plan implies cross-team dependencies ... that warrant B4–B7.'

expectations.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
expectations.evidence: B1 ends with 'Verdict: SUSTAINED.' and notes 'None of the three themes are framed this way' (referring to A2 problem-statement format).

expectations.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
expectations.evidence: B2 table has all six rows marked SUSTAINED, including 'Onboarding rewrite — likely touches auth, signup, identity, marketing copy, analytics events ... None named.' Concludes 'Six SUSTAINED in B2.'

expectations.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
expectations.evidence: B3 flags shareable-shortlist assumption as '0.5 (anecdote)' and push notifications/onboarding as '0.1 (assumption)' — all three rows verdict SUSTAINED.

expectations.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
expectations.evidence: B3 table column 'Confidence (Gilad)' contains numeric values: 0.5, 0.1, 0.1. Plus statement 'All three Confidence scores are below the 5 threshold.'
'REVISE — bordering on KILL.' under the Recommendation section.

expectations.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
expectations.evidence: Condition 2: 'Run idea-triage on each of the three themes before they re-enter the roadmap, producing an ICE score and Confidence scores.'

expectations.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
expectations.evidence: Multiple buckets carry explicit falsifying conditions, e.g. B1: 'Falsifying condition: plan author can produce a written problem statement per theme in the A2 format with a named customer segment, named target metric, and quantified target.' B2 and B4 tables also list falsifying conditions per row.
